original.title: Android app developers will soon have to share their address publicly
original.summary: Independent Android app developers are worried about their privacy after Google announced that from next year many of them will be required to share a phone number and address publicly. The policy change is intended to meet European Union regulations under the Digital Services Act, but Google says contact details will be made public worldwide. […]
original.podcastScript:
Hello, this is Earth Signal.

Today's story comes from The Verge: Android app developers will soon have to share their address publicly.

The report says: Independent Android app developers are worried about their privacy after Google announced that from next year many of them will be required to share a phone number and address publicly. The policy change is intended to meet European Union regulations under the Digital Services Act, but Google says contact details will be made public worldwide. […]

The signal is the longer trend behind the headline: how technology keeps moving into public life, infrastructure, science and everyday decisions.
original.aiInsight: The important signal is not just the event, but the system it points to: technology is becoming part of how societies manage risk, opportunity and trust.

zh.title: 人工智能新闻释放新的社会信号
zh.summary: 这条新闻关注人工智能的新动作，背后反映技术扩张、公共规则和日常生活之间的关系。
zh.podcastScript:
今天的 Earth Signal 来自全球科技新闻现场。

我们关注的是：人工智能新闻释放新的社会信号。这条新闻关注人工智能的新动作，背后反映技术扩张、公共规则和日常生活之间的关系。

如果把它放在更长的时间线上看，这不只是一次技术更新。它说明科技正在更深地进入城市、公共服务、环境风险和普通人的日常选择。

值得听的地方在于：真正改变生活的，往往不是某个单点发明，而是它和社会系统连接起来之后，开始重新分配效率、风险和机会。

今天的信号是：技术越靠近地球，越需要被听见的不只是速度，还有它会把我们带向怎样的生活。
zh.aiInsight: 人工智能的长期信号不只是模型更强，而是它正在进入社会运行的底层。普通人需要关注的，是技术如何参与决策，以及这些决策是否仍然能被理解和监督。
